mudengine art samples

Thirty pictures the client draws for MajorMUD and its derivatives: ten rooms, ten items and ten character portraits. 22 October 2026.

Rooms

Top-down room pictures drawn from the room’s name and description in the GreaterMUD world data. The client shows one in the game view when the character stands in the room.

Items

Item pictures drawn from the item’s name, shown in the inventory and shop views.

Characters

Portraits drawn from the character’s race, class, gender, hair and eyes, and from the stat sentences the game prints: health, strength, agility, charm, intellect and willpower.
